capabilities: Define simplices and hyperedges in notes via inline markers or YAML frontmatter
Render clusters as organic blob fields with a living force-based layout
Compute Betti numbers and persistent homology over the vault's relations
Infer edges and suggest missing connections from tags, links, folders, and content
Log relation transformations in an append-only history file
extras: README documents privacy stance (no network requests) and includes a linked section on what the analysis does not prove; a full engineering specification is available at SPEC.md.
problem: Obsidian's graph view only shows pairwise links, so it cannot represent groups of notes that are meaningful only as a whole.
summary: Knowledge graph plugin that models note clusters as simplicial complexes and hyperedges, rendered as organic fields with topological analysis.
